protocol: Two fresh browser contexts per priority pair, two normal rounds and a third with requestIdleCallback/cancelIdleCallback removed before page startup. Order alternates, same generated 24 JPEG data, direct reading and native click, shared browser/driver caches. CPU submission, not display latency. Synthetic simultaneous opposing KeyboardEvent commands test cancellation, not native input latency. Priority ON extends pause through first effective motion; OFF leaves background scheduling unchanged. Final policy opt-in, because neither renderer showed a first-motion benefit in these pairs.
